logo:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a new premium minimalist identity logo for "Coiffure Aymen", men's hairdresser, children’s haircuts and barber in Pontchâteau France. Actual brand will be "AYMEN", with clear hair/barber descriptor. One transparent-background PNG, not a mockup.
Design an original poised architectural capital A emblem. Its two clean stems are joined by a slim straight-razor-shaped crossbar or a precisely clipped negative-space horizontal blade detail, immediately suggesting the precision of a barber without literal illustrated tools. The emblem is elegant, exceptionally simple, legible small, not a sports/esports/car brand or decorative crest. No crossed scissors, beard head mascot, crown, laurel, hair swoosh, circle badge or vintage seal.
Wide horizontal lockup: distinctive A emblem on left, bespoke tightly drawn compact uppercase wordmark "AYMEN" on right, confident strong moderately condensed grotesk lettering. Fine restrained angled cuts echo the precision cut of the emblem but keep all letters plainly readable. Typographic character feels craft, warm and contemporary; NOT sci-fi. Optical kerning, strong silhouette.
Under wordmark, small widely spaced clean sans descriptor exactly "COIFFURE & BARBIER", and a smaller line exactly "PONTCHÂTEAU". Correct circumflex Â.
Color: ALL artwork one flat matte amber #D5AC62. No metallic shading, no bevels, no gradients, no texture, no shadow, no 3D. Background genuine transparent alpha, no black/white rectangle. Wide composition roughly 2:1 aspect, at least 8% transparent safe margin on every side; no clipping. Emblem no taller than the complete wordmark+descriptor lockup.
Output precise refined logo artwork only, no extra words, dates, rating, established year, phone, tagline, mockup, paper or watermark.

Create ONE memorable premium FULL PAGE WEBSITE DESIGN STUDY for Coiffure Aymen, Pontchâteau. Tall flat complete desktop page, approximately 1100px wide x 3100px high, from header to footer. No device/browser frame, external labels or moodboard. MODEL 3: "LE FAUTEUIL SIGNATURE".

Keep the existing recognizable yellow/orange sign and glass entrance; do not repaint it or substitute a fabricated luxury premises. Remove screenshot UI.
Palette charcoal #101110, amber #D5AC62, ivory #EFE7D8 and tobacco #694934. Warm cinematic traditional craft translated into a contemporary identity. Strong bold moderately condensed sans, clean microcopy, oversized Yellowtail-like amber handwritten "Aymen". Main ivory bold headline lower-left "PRENEZ PLACE." with small "COIFFURE HOMME · ENFANT · BARBE". Small "Sans rendez-vous" and CTA. The chair and wordmark should form an unforgettable sculptural but fully photographic composition.
2 CRAFT (21%): immersive full-bleed BLACK AND WHITE photographic montage arranged as two broad diagonal joined planes, with a third smaller macro plane at edge: adult haircut hand/clipper, child haircut from side/rear with no posed portrait, beard contouring closeup. Tiny "Homme · Enfant · Barbe". All images editorial/illustrative, not named real Aymen staff or client results.
3 THE REAL BUSINESS (20%): the actual storefront photo input5 full width, yellow/orange Coiffeur Aymen sign and glass entrance intact and recognizable, sidewalk and corner geometry as original. Keep photographic color natural with subtle charcoal scrim for typography. Bold text "AYMEN," / "À PONTCHÂTEAU." near lower-left, small address "2 rue Maurice Sambron". A neat "Voir l'itinéraire" button at lower right. No invented redesign of facade, no rewritten visible prices or fake physical new logo installed on sign.
4 VALUES/SERVICES (14%): ONLY solid charcoal scene with confident matte amber large type "VOTRE ALLURE." / ivory "NOTRE ATTENTION." across a bold centered editorial grid. Thin amber horizontal rules and three small INLINE service labels "Coupe homme · Coupe enfant · Barbe & contours". A very large quiet outline A emblem at left edge, cut off by viewport, flat graphic NOT a 3D object. No stacked feature list, cards, prices or ratings. 5 CONTACT (16%): warm extremely realistic close photographic crop of barber hands finishing a hot-towel/neck/cape gesture on an adult, no full named face, soft dark photographic surroundings. All visitor copy in FRENCH, exact accents, impeccably readable. No online appointment CTA, no Planity, no calendar, no no-wait promise, prices, opening hours, awards, invented reviews, founding year or social handle. Avoid repeating one split text/photo template in every scene. Strong asymmetric composition, exquisite real material photography, straight/diagonal transitions that feel inspired by a barber's precision.
